description: One movement of one item in one warehouse. Written only by knit360_core.stock.ledger, never edited, never deleted.

fields.label: Item
fields.description: FR-INV-002: Stock Quantity -- the item that moved.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.description: FR-INV-002: Stock Quantity -- stock is counted per item per warehouse. A Bin is a place to walk to, not a quantity.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: FR-INV-002: Stock Quantity -- whose stock this is.

fields.label: Posting Date
fields.description: FR-INV-002: Stock Quantity -- when the movement happened. Movements are replayed in this order to value an issue.

fields.label: Voucher Type
fields.description: FR-INV-002: Stock Quantity -- the kind of document that moved it.

fields.label: Voucher
fields.description: FR-INV-002: Stock Quantity -- the document that moved it. Every movement has one; nothing moves stock on its own.

fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: FR-INV-002: Stock Quantity -- signed. Positive is received, negative is issued. The stock held is the sum of these.

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: FR-INV-006: Stock Valuation -- what one unit was worth in this movement. On an issue this is worked out by the ledger, not supplied by the document.

fields.label: Value Change
fields.description: FR-INV-006: Stock Valuation -- signed money. The value of the stock held is the sum of these, and it is what the ledger posts.

fields.label: Cancelled
fields.description: FR-INV-002: Stock Quantity -- set on both an original and its mirror when a document is reversed, so a query that excludes them sees neither.

fields.label: Remarks
fields.description: FR-INV-002: Stock Quantity -- why this movement happened, where the document does not already say.

name: KNIT 360 Stock Ledger Entry
